content: {DRAFT} If Time Validation is enabled for a Time Base (refer to SWS_StbM_00464 , SWS_StbM_00465 ), upon invocation of StbM_EthSetPdelayResponderData() the StbM shall write the content of the structure, which is passed by parameter measureDataPtr , to an internal Time Base specific buffer .
